title: 定位器
summary: 页面变长时只是滚动更多。真正要先定的是意图：是连续阅读、结构跳转、折叠展开，还是行内检索与筛选。
summaryEn: A longer page just means more scrolling. First decide the user's intent: continuous reading, structural jump, progressive disclosure, or in-page search and filtering.
asks: 长页面里，用户怎么知道自己在哪里、怎么快速到达目标？
asksEn: How do users know where they are on a long page, and how do they reach their target?

links.when: 页面内定位不是整站全局路由
links.whenEn: in-page navigation is not site-wide routing

links.when: 阅读进度不是滚动条皮肤
links.whenEn: reading progress is not scrollbar chrome

links.when: 大纲锚点不是页签切换
links.whenEn: outline anchors are not tab switching

links.when: 分步向导不是表单字段按需披露
links.whenEn: steppers are not progressive form disclosure
